body:
I have been using the application for many years and to be honest I don't want to exchange it. It is comfortable online and offline alike. It became my daily tool in almost everything I do from sport diary till job scheduling. 
 There is one problem I hate the application for: if the text is big in a cell (longer than the screen width) it is hard to edit it since there's no swiping the text. You need to put a cursor and hold it till you scroll with it while getting to the spot you want to edit. This thing wasn't in the first versions of this Ap. but since  around 2018 it is hard to edit. I usually use another program like Word or One-Note to edit and I insert the edited piece into the cell. Double work!

title: Very user friendly and useful
body:
This is a very user friendly app. Especially on the iPad. Not exactly for the iPhone, in sense that it is good only for very simple data insertion on the small screen of the phone. 
But on the PC or on iPad it is a completely different story. Very user friendly and fast. 
Yet I would like some other options be available on the iPad as we'll for example adding notes. I have many notes to add to data boxes yet there is no possibility to do so on the mobile version. 
Still, I use this app quite a lot
